troubleshooting: Too many points: Downscale with Fit TOP first
No output: Ensure TOP input is connected and cooking
Wrong size: Enable Override Size and set desired dimensions
Dimension mismatch: Check Override Resolution settings
description: Converts TOP pixel data to POP points. Supports 6 interpretation modes: Color (RGBA), Position and Active (RGB+alpha), Position (RGB), Depth (camera unprojection with FOFocal/Optical Center), Height (displacement with scale), and Custom. Depth page enables accurate 3D reconstruction from depth cameras. Multiple TOPs can be chained for multi-attribute point clouds.
